links.outcome: MLLM performance on multi-sequence CMR image understanding, report generation, and diagnosis versus public benchmark performance
links.effect: Models perform poorly overall, with performance degrading along the real CMR workflow, despite strong performance on public medical benchmarks.
links.quote: Across 24 state-of-the-art MLLMs, CardioLens reveals a substantial clinical reality gap: models perform poorly overall, with performance degrading along the real CMR workflow.

links.outcome: Sensitivity of MLLM performance to input slice selection protocols and slice budgets
links.effect: Comparing random, clinically motivated, and data-driven slice selection under different slice budgets, performance changed only marginally, typically by about 1%.
links.quote: To rule out MLLM-compatible input construction as the primary cause, we compare random, clinically motivated, and data-driven slice selection protocols under different slice budgets; performance changes only marginally, typically by about 1%.
